definitions.axis_accuracy: chart-level valid-axis rate. Numeric/value axes require >=2 predicted encrypted ticks and pixels; text/category axes require >=1. Denominator is current cleaned GT charts in scope.
definitions.tick_value_mae: mean absolute error over comparable numeric GT tick positions by axis order using *_ticks_encrypted when present. Missing/non-numeric predictions are excluded from MAE but count wrong for tick-value accuracy.
definitions.tick_value_accuracy: tick-level value accuracy over all GT ticks by axis order; missing predictions count incorrect; numeric tolerance is 1e-6 and text uses normalized exact match.
definitions.legend_color_nearest_palette_accuracy: series charts match by label with positional/single fallback; scatter/bubble match object labels from data_points. A predicted color is correct if its nearest GT palette color equals the matched GT object/series color.
definitions.point_label_name_accuracy: scatter/bubble only. GT object labels from data_points keys; correct if normalized label appears in predicted colors[].name.
definitions.text_axis_accuracy: accuracy over text/category axis tick labels only; numeric axes excluded.
definitions.rerun_note: Regenerated after rerunning current high-error negative samples against the latest system code on 2026-06-01.
